>
> 名字全小写，带横杠 —— 和 `dsh-video-storyboard` 同一个风格。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**English TL;DR** — a DSH plugin that watches a video *together* with the agent, in sync with the re"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"al
